overview.title: Service overview
overview.content: Data Foundations & AI Activation focuses on the prerequisite most enterprises skip: reliable, well-owned data. We help you define sources of truth, lineage, and access controls, then package high-value AI use cases as repeatable patterns. Work connects naturally to MLOps Setup and Agent Building when you are ready to industrialise models and agents.
